new.n: Stolen express silver (~$900) buried between St. Charles and Dover
new.pl: Midway between St. Charles and Dover, about 6 km apart along the Great Western line; escape trail not mapped
new.st: 29 Aug 1913: two men allegedly robbed the Great Western station at St. Charles of a $1,000 express package. Caught with $100 in half-dollars, they were believed to have buried the other ~$900, all in silver, somewhere between St. Charles and Dover. Residents searched the underbrush, ravines and woods along the escape trail; no recovery was reported. Private land: permission. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
new.t: Silver half-dollars respond well to a detector. Follow-up reports (trial, confession) might narrow the route. Private land: permission.
pinev: Corridor-level: midway between GNIS Saint Charles and Dover, about 6 km apart along the Great Western line; r 3.5 km covers the escape route.
